subject.title: Cron session accumulation can silently exhaust agent context window — no guardrails or warnings

question: Should this issue stay as the umbrella until the active cadence and retention PRs land, or should maintainers split/narrow the remaining cron guardrail work now?
rationale: The source-backed retention bug is real, but the full requested direction spans compatibility-sensitive session lifecycle cleanup and an operator-facing cron cadence policy that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until PRs Settle
options.body: Track the combined user problem here while reviewing the retention and cadence PRs, then split only verified leftovers after those decisions land.

options.title: Split Remaining Work Now
options.body: Make retention, cadence, context-warning, and sessions-cleanup separate canonical issues before narrowing or closing this umbrella.

options.title: Narrow To Retention Only
options.body: Keep the source-backed retention bug path open but explicitly drop or defer the cadence/context guardrail slice from core.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until PRs Settle
recommendation.body: Track the combined user problem here while reviewing the retention and cadence PRs, then split only verified leftovers after those decisions land.
